gorillaUpdate.notes: [required] Discovery: Gorilla reads the moves list as Discovery saves it after its update (no more "layout I don't know" or "Move list readback failed"), and a paired move that needs a free number goes in too (no more "Unmapped move hash reference"). A pack whose older version left files behind after TRIBUTE's update is added again: Gorilla asks once and keeps your old files in Gorilla Backups.
